mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially reducing primaquine metabolism and efficacy, while primaquine may inhibit phenytoin metabolism; primaquine also carries risk of hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients on concurrent medications.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels and antimalarial efficacy; counsel on G6PD status prior to primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if G6PD deficiency present or adjust phenytoin dosing if interaction suspected.
